item.title: IPO da Anthropic concentra interesse de investidores no mercado de IA
item.description: O calendário de ofertas públicas iniciais de ações (IPO) do setor de tecnologia, que antes era bastante robusto, agora se resume apenas à Anthropic.
item.dc:creator: Echo Wang
item.content:encoded: O calendário de ofertas públicas iniciais de ações (IPO) do setor de tecnologia, que antes era bastante robusto, agora se resume apenas à Anthropic. A companhia de inteligência artificial está seguindo em frente para realizar seu IPO em meados de novembro, após prever a divulgação do prospecto da operação no final deste mês, segundo fontes a par do assunto, que alertam que o plano e as datas estão sujeitos a alterações. O IPO da Anthropic testará se sua posição no centro do próspero setor de IA, que alguns investidores acreditam ser digna de uma avaliação potencial de US$1,5 trilhão, será capaz de superar um ambiente de mercado que normalmente levaria banqueiros e advogados especializados em transações a aconselhar um adiamento. O mercado espera que a Anthropic comece a negociar suas ações para investidores em potencial durante a semana de 9 de novembro, disse uma das fontes. Outras empresas dos setores de infraestrutura de inteligência artificial e centrais de processamento de dados adiaram suas aberturas de capital, enfrentando um aumento nas taxas de juros que ajudou a alimentar uma onda de vendas maciças de ações e títulos de dívida de operadores de IA, como a CoreWeave (CRWV.O) , além de questionamentos mais amplos sobre a sustentabilidade dos gastos com a tecnologia. Esse contraste ressalta o apelo da Anthropic aos investidores, mesmo com as preocupações sobre a concorrência de modelos de código aberto e a segurança da IA pesando sobre o setor. A Anthropic se recusou a comentar. AVALIAÇÕES SOB PRESSÃO A retração do setor de IA segue uma série de adiamentos e cancelamentos de IPOs desde setembro, à medida que a volatilidade do mercado e o aumento das taxas de juros tornaram mais difícil para as empresas garantirem preços atraentes. A Switch, operadora de data centers, e a Nscale, provedora de infraestrutura de IA, adiaram seus planos de IPO para o final deste ano, disseram fontes a par do assunto, embora tenham enfatizado que os planos permanecem em aberto e sujeitos a alterações. A SB Energy, apoiada pela SoftBank, também adiou sua abertura de capital, conforme noticiado anteriormente pela Reuters. A NScale se recusou a comentar. A Switch não respondeu imediatamente a um pedido de comentário. A Elice, startup sul-coreana de chips de IA, foi uma das últimas a arquivar seus planos de abertura de capital da noite para o dia. A AirTrunk REIT, apoiada pela Blackstone, e a Firmus, apoiada pela Nvidia (NVDA.O) , também retiraram ou suspenderam suas ofertas, segundo reportagem da Reuters. O recente IPO da Oura aumentou a cautela entre os emissores em potencial. A oferta atraiu pouca participação de investidores que operam apenas com posições compradas, disse uma fonte a par do assunto, levantando preocupações sobre o tamanho da demanda por parte de investidores institucionais, que normalmente fornecem uma base estável de acionistas para empresas recém-listadas.

item.title: Rooney labels Man United players 'selfish' after Fernandes criticism
item.description: Manchester United's all-time leading scorer Wayne Rooney called the club's players "selfish" and said they were "like babies" after captain Bruno Fernandes questioned the coaching staff's tactics following Wednesday's 4-1 Champions League thrashing by Como.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Manchester United's all-time leading scorer Wayne Rooney called the club's players "selfish" and said they were "like babies" after captain [USN:L6N4671CM TEXT:"Bruno Fernandes questioned"] the coaching staff's tactics following Wednesday's 4-1 Champions League [USN:L6N46717X TEXT:"thrashing by Como"]. Fernandes said United failed to apply enough pressure and adopted a "mood of defeat" after conceding in the second minute, as the heavy loss intensified scrutiny of manager Michael Carrick. United's collapse at Como left them staring at another damaging defeat, with only a stoppage-time goal from Joshua Zirkzee reducing the margin of loss. The criticism follows signs of growing frustration within the squad. Earlier this month, [USN:L8N4612C3 TEXT:"defender Lisandro Martinez criticised"] the club's hierarchy after a 2-0 Champions League defeat by Atletico Madrid, saying he expected greater investment to help the team compete at the highest level. "When Martinez came out, I said this is an absolute nightmare because it will rip the dressing room apart," Rooney told the United Stand podcast on Thursday. "That was the start. We've seen it now with Bruno and you're going to see it with more players because they don't want to take responsibility. "You can say whether Bruno was right or wrong in what he said but you have to take responsibility on the pitch. You have to take responsibility as a group of players. "These players, they're selfish. They don't care about their teammates, don't care about the manager, the staff or the fans, they care about themselves. "If they're not getting what's right for them, they're like babies and just throw. their toys out of the pram and go and deflect the blame on to anyone else but themselves." Carrick, a former United midfielder who played alongside Rooney at Old Trafford, was appointed on an interim basis following [USN:L1N3Y607S TEXT:"Ruben Amorim's dismissal"] in January before [USN:L1N41Z0BH TEXT:"earning a contract through 2028"] after overseeing a dramatic improvement in results. Carrick is under growing pressure with United winless in seven matches across all competitions. They are 20th in the Champions League standings and 13th in the Premier League.

item.title: Louisiana court buys AI servers to test how tech can streamline workload
item.description: A Louisiana state courthouse across the Mississippi River from New Orleans has a new addition: two AI servers to power new tools to support court staff and judges.
item.dc:creator: Sara Merken
item.content:encoded: A Louisiana state courthouse across the Mississippi River from New Orleans has a new addition: two AI servers to power new tools to support court staff and judges. The servers and supporting equipment, installed about a month ago in Louisiana's Fifth Circuit Court of Appeal in Gretna, are part of the court's plan to create its own AI applications even as it continues to experiment with other commercially available options, Judge Scott Schlegel and Chief Judge Susan Chehardy wrote in a Substack post on Tuesday. "Token prices, subscriptions, and the costs of operating AI will likely look quite different a few years from now," the judges wrote. "Rather than bet entirely on one approach, we decided to pursue both and learn from the experience." The court bought two Dell servers with Nvidia chips that cost about $65,000 each at the time of purchase, Schlegel told Reuters. He said the court is not endorsing a particular product and other courts should evaluate their specific needs. The Louisiana court appears to be the first state court to announce such a move, even as state and federal courts around the country have been putting in place rules and guidelines for how judges and court staff are permitted to use AI. On the federal level, the clerk's office of the New Orleans-based 5th US Circuit Court of Appeals uses local servers to support case processing applications, which includes incorporating "limited AI" to increase efficiency and productivity, Thomas Plunkett, the clerk of the court, told Reuters. Sixty percent of judges in a random-sample survey released in March said they are using at least one AI tool in their work, according to the [USN:L6N40I18R TEXT:"study"] by Northwestern University researchers. The Louisiana state court is working with the nonprofit Institute for the Advancement of Legal and Ethical AI (ALEA Institute) to develop AI applications. Schlegel told Reuters the project began by interviewing court staff and clerks to see where the technology would be useful. “Can it assist, should it assist, and in what sense should it assist? Augment, not replace,” he said. The judges said early efforts will focus on the intake and compliance process when documents are submitted. The court hopes to later build capabilities to help signal when filings include nonexistent cases and check documents for hidden instructions meant to manipulate AI systems, they wrote. Future applications could also help staff lawyers craft bench memoranda, which are documents meant to help prepare a judge. Northwestern law professor Daniel Linna, who co-authored the study on judges' AI use, told Reuters this week that he wasn’t aware of many judges building AI tools. He and students at Northwestern built a prototype of a tool in collaboration with a judge to review Social Security disability benefits decisions, and are working with other judges on a case management project. There is upside in "creating domain-specific tools that you can put some guardrails and other things in place to make sure you’re getting the kind of accuracy that you’d want to have for that work,” he said.

item.title: Camioneros del sur de Italia suavizan protestas tras aprobación de ayudas por parte del Gobierno
item.description: Las protestas de los camioneros, que han afectado gravemente al suministro de combustible y alimentos en el sur de Italia, se suavizaron el jueves, después de que el Gobierno de la primera ministra Giorgia Meloni aprobara ayudas y adoptara una postura más firme frente a los cortes de carretera.
item.dc:creator: Francesca Piscioneri, Alvise Armellini
item.content:encoded: Las protestas de los camioneros, que han afectado gravemente al suministro de combustible y alimentos en el sur de Italia, se suavizaron el jueves, después de que el Gobierno de la primera ministra Giorgia Meloni aprobara ayudas y adoptara una postura más firme frente a los cortes de carretera. Desde la semana pasada, los transportistas han estado bloqueando carreteras y autopistas para protestar contra los elevados precios del combustible y exigir ayudas para reducirlos, pero sus representantes afirmaron que los cortes de carretera se levantarían en Sicilia tras las conversaciones con el Gobierno. Los camioneros de Calabria también suspendieron su protesta, mientras que Vincenzo Parisi, en nombre de los transportistas de la región de Campania, en los alrededores de Nápoles, declaró a la radio pública RAI que esperaba que los cortes de carretera pudieran levantarse en la zona a lo largo del jueves. El Consejo de Ministros aprobó un decreto con más desgravaciones fiscales para los camioneros afectados por el aumento de los costos del combustible, añadiendo 106 millones de euros (118,66 millones de dólares) a los 434 millones ofrecidos antes y destinando 60 millones a los agricultores y 10 millones al sector pesquero. "Quiero dar las gracias a las asociaciones que optaron por el diálogo y suspendieron los paros y las manifestaciones. Ha sido un acto de responsabilidad", declaró Meloni en las redes sociales. Las protestas provocaron "graves trastornos" en Campania, lo que limitó el abastecimiento a supermercados, gasolineras y hospitales, declaró el viceministro de Infraestructuras, Edoardo Rixi, a la emisora de radio RAI. Sin embargo, la oficina de Meloni tachó de "ridícula" una noticia de portada del periódico de la oposición Il Fatto Quotidiano según la cual la sede del Gobierno en Roma se estaba quedando sin papel higiénico debido a los bloqueos de los camioneros. En Nápoles, la escasez de combustible dificultaba que los médicos llegaran a los hospitales o que las ambulancias respondieran a las emergencias, y también ponía en peligro la recogida municipal de residuos, según el alcalde Gaetano Manfredi. (1 dólar = 0,8925 euros)

item.title: Hitachi Energy anuncia nova unidade produtiva no Brasil e eleva plano de aportes a US$350 mi
item.description: A Hitachi Energy vai construir uma nova unidade no Brasil dedicada à fabricação de componentes para transformadores de energia, um projeto que envolverá US$77 milhões em investimentos e visa ampliar a oferta desses produtos essenciais à infraestrutura elétrica, anunciou a companhia nesta quinta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Leticia Augusto
item.content:encoded: A Hitachi Energy vai construir uma nova unidade no Brasil dedicada à fabricação de componentes para transformadores de energia, um projeto que envolverá US$77 milhões em investimentos e visa ampliar a oferta desses produtos essenciais à infraestrutura elétrica, anunciou a companhia nesta quinta-feira. Com a iniciativa, a subsidiária do grupo japonês Hitachi (6501.T) eleva para US$350 milhões seu plano atual de investimentos no Brasil, onde a empresa vai mais do que dobrar a capacidade produtiva em um momento de demanda mundial aquecida, disseram executivos à Reuters. O investimento acompanha aportes globais de [USN:L1N3UQ0Z6 TEXT:"US$9 bilhões"] para ampliar a produção desses equipamentos em resposta à necessidade de ampliação e reforço da infraestrutura elétrica no mundo, dada a eletrificação das economias e aumento do consumo de energia para data centers e inteligência artificial. A nova planta da Hitachi Energy para produzir componentes como buchas e comutadores ficará em Pindamonhangaba (SP), anexa à unidade que a companhia está construindo atualmente para fabricar transformadores de alta tensão. Parte dos recursos também irá para expandir a produção de materiais de isolamento elétrico na unidade da companhia em Guarulhos (SP). No Brasil, a companhia anunciou em 2024 a expansão de sua fábrica em Guarulhos e desde então vem ampliando o volume de aportes, com as novas unidades planejadas em Pindamonhangaba e um centro de serviços na região da Grande São Paulo. "Quando falamos em investimento, não nos importamos de investir ainda mais, porque acreditamos que a visibilidade de longo prazo junto aos nossos clientes nos dá vantagem para entender onde precisamos investir mais", disse Bruno Melles, CEO Global da Unidade de Negócios de Transformadores da Hitachi Energy. Os componentes fabricados no interior de São Paulo serão empregados na cadeia produtiva interna da Hitachi Energy, que opera de forma verticalizada, tanto no Brasil quanto no exterior. "Brasil e Colômbia também são países exportadores (de produtos da Hitachi Energy), queremos garantir que vamos atender outros mercados, em especial a América do Norte e o Oriente Médio", afirmou Melles. Ele acrescentou que os produtos também poderão ser vendidos a empresas concorrentes do setor que têm a Hitachi Energy como fornecedora. Na visão da companhia, ampliar sua capacidade no Brasil reduz a exposição a interrupções globais e contribui para maior previsibilidade em custos, produção e prazos de entrega, ajudando a atender mais rapidamente clientes do mercado brasileiro e internacional. A unidade de componentes deverá estar pronta no fim de 2028, cerca de um ano depois da nova fábrica de transformadores, prevista para novembro de 2027, segundo Alexandre Malveiro, vice-presidente sênior para América Latina da Unidade de Negócios de Transformadores da Hitachi Energy. "Com esse investimento, estamos falando de cerca de 120 novos empregos diretos, que se somam aos 450 que já anunciamos para o outro projeto em Pindamonhangaba", destacou Malveiro.

item.title: Janela de importação de etanol pelo Brasil, que beneficia os EUA, deve ser reaberta
item.description: A janela de importação de etanol do Brasil, utilizada principalmente por exportadores de combustível dos Estados Unidos, deve ser reaberta entre dezembro e janeiro, apesar de uma produção recorde esperada para o país em 2026/27, afirmaram a corretora StoneX e a consultoria Argus.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A janela de importação de etanol do Brasil, utilizada principalmente por exportadores de combustível dos Estados Unidos, deve ser reaberta entre dezembro e janeiro, apesar de uma produção recorde esperada para o país em 2026/27, afirmaram a corretora StoneX e a consultoria Argus. A corretora espera que a janela seja aberta para chegadas ao porto de Suape, prevendo que o primeiro trimestre de 2027 seja semelhante ao mesmo período de 2026, quando o etanol anidro chegou por Pernambuco. "A nova previsão surpreende, em uma safra com expectativas de produção recorde de etanol", disse Maria Lígia Barros, responsável por precificação de etanol da Argus, à Reuters. Segundo ela, a possibilidade de importação é ancorada pela visão de um balanço mais apertado de oferta e demanda até o fim da safra, devido a chuvas trazidas pelo El Niño, que prejudicaram a moagem de cana no centro-sul, além de benefícios governamentais concedidos ao etanol hidratado. Interrupções sucessivas na moagem penalizam mais o anidro que o hidratado, pois sua produção exige etapas adicionais, explicou a Argus, citando ainda que o hidratado está desonerado do PIS/Cofins até 9 de novembro. De acordo com a Argus, o Brasil pode importar entre 150 milhões e 200 milhões de litros de etanol entre outubro de 2026 e março de 2027. Mas a maior parte dos desembarques deve ficar concentrada entre dezembro de 2026 e fevereiro de 2027. No mesmo período anterior, o Brasil importou 228,3 milhões de litros, segundo dados compilados pela Argus. A janela de importação do Brasil se abre quando o custo de importação do etanol dos EUA -- incluindo frete, taxa de câmbio, a tarifa de 18% e custos portuários -- fica abaixo do preço do etanol anidro nacional no Nordeste do Brasil. As importações tinham aumentado no Brasil no início do ano, levando a balança comercial do setor a um saldo negativo de janeiro a março, já que o etanol dos EUA chegou ao Nordeste a um preço mais baixo do que o etanol anidro nacional, apesar da tarifa de importação de 18%, lembrou a StoneX. A balança comercial de etanol do Brasil voltou a ficar positiva a partir de abril, indicou a StoneX. As exportações brasileiras de etanol, no entanto, caíram 17% no acumulado do ano, para 1,03 bilhão de litros, pressionadas por uma queda de 34,1% na demanda por etanol industrial, enquanto os embarques de etanol combustível aumentaram 31,7%, pontuou a corretora. A previsão pressupõe frete estável, aumento dos preços do etanol nacional e etanol norte-americano mais barato, o que reduziria a diferença de preço durante a entressafra da cana-de-açúcar brasileira, de dezembro a março. (Reportagem de Marcelo Teixeira e Roberto Samora)

item.title: Trump asks Musk to lift Ukraine Starlink restrictions, WSJ reports
item.description: US President Donald Trump called Elon Musk and asked him to lift restrictions on Ukraine's use of Starlink, the Wall Street Journal reported on Thursday, citing US officials.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump called Elon Musk and asked him to lift restrictions on Ukraine's use of Starlink, the Wall Street Journal reported on Thursday, citing US officials. The Starlink system was working more normally on Thursday, shortly after the Trump-Musk conversation, according to US and Ukrainian officials cited by the Journal. Some Ukrainian officials told the newspaper the system was not restored to full functionality but was working at higher speeds than under the cap. President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said earlier on Thursday that Starlink speed had not been restored for Ukraine, adding that he hoped for talks with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio in the coming days. Trump told Musk he was frustrated the system's speeds remained capped at around 100 mph (160 kph), the Journal said, citing officials. Rubio said on Wednesday that decisions regarding Ukraine's access to Starlink were up to its parent company SpaceX and its CEO Musk, not the White House. Ukraine uses Starlink for battlefield communications and drone operations. Restricting the satellite service [USN:L8N4600M6 TEXT:"hampered "]the country's attack and air defense drone missions against Russia.

item.title: Seahawks activate RB Zach Charbonnet from PUP list
item.description: The Seattle Seahawks activated running back Zach Charbonnet from the physically unable to perform list on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Seattle Seahawks activated running back Zach Charbonnet from the physically unable to perform list on Thursday. To make room on the active roster, the team placed tight end Elijah Arroyo on injured reserve with a shoulder injury. Head coach Mike Macdonald said earlier this week that Charbonnet is not guaranteed to play Sunday night when the Seahawks (3-3) host the Kansas City Chiefs (5-0). "Zach is going to have a full week's worth of reps, so that's exciting, and there's a possibility that you could see him on Sunday in some capacity, so that's exciting," Macdonald said on Monday. Charbonnet, 25, is nine months removed from tearing his ACL in the NFC divisional round win against San Francisco on Jan. 17. He returned to practice on Oct. 1 and Thursday marked the end of his 21-day practice window, meaning Seattle had to put him on the 53-man roster or shut him down for the season. "It's remarkable," Macdonald said. "I know he's had a certain date in mind, which is a really ambitious date. Those who have tried to come back from a significant knee surgery understand the undertaking that it takes. Zach's a beast. He looks great. It's not easy to say, 'All right, let's go.' So for him to have that courage to say that and work through the things he's worked through, you can't do anything but tip your cap to him." Charbonnet led the Seahawks in rushing touchdowns (12) and was second in rushing yards (730) last season. He has totaled 1,761 rushing yards and 21 TDs on the ground in 49 career games (eight starts) since the Seahawks drafted him in the second round in 2023. ESPN reported that Arroyo underwent season-ending surgery on Thursday to repair the shoulder he injured in last Thursday's loss at Denver. Arroyo, 23, has one catch for 17 yards in six games this season. He has 16 receptions for 196 yards and one TD in 19 games (four starts) since Seattle selected him in the second round in 2025. --Field Level Media

item.title: Hitachi Energy to invest $77 million in new Brazil plant
item.description: Hitachi Energy will build a new plant in Brazil to produce components for power transformers, the company said on Thursday, in a $77 million investment aimed at expanding supplies of equipment essential to power infrastructure.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Hitachi Energy will build a new plant in Brazil to produce components for power transformers, the company said on Thursday, in a $77 million investment aimed at expanding supplies of equipment essential to power infrastructure. The announcement brings the current investment plan of the energy unit of Japanese conglomerate Hitachi (6501.T) in Brazil to $350 million, the firm said in an interview, adding that it would more than double its production capacity in the segment. The new plant will be located in Pindamonhangaba, Sao Paulo state, adjacent to a facility the company is building to manufacture high-voltage transformers The unit will make components such as bushings and tap changers The facility will supply the Brazilian market and other strategic export destinations, including North America and the Middle East Part of the investment will also be used to expand the production of electrical insulation materials at the firm's facility in Guarulhos, Sao Paulo state

item.title: Senators G Linus Ullmark put on IR with lower-body injury
item.description: The Ottawa Senators placed starting goaltender Linus Ullmark on injured reserve Thursday due to a lower-body injury.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Ottawa Senators placed starting goaltender Linus Ullmark on injured reserve Thursday due to a lower-body injury. The injury occurred Wednesday night in the third period of Ottawa's 5-1 win over the Florida Panthers. Ullmark was replaced by backup Samuel Ersson. Ersson is expected to take over as the Senators' primary goaltender. Ottawa recalled Jonas Johansson from Belleville of the American Hockey League. Johansson was acquired in a September trade with the Tampa Bay Lightning. Ullmark, 33, is off to a strong start to the 2026-27 season, posting a 7-1-0 record with a .945 save percentage and a 1.33 goals-against average. Before leaving Wednesday's game, he stopped 17 of 18 shots. Ersson, 27, has appeared in four games, going 0-2 with a .831 save percentage and a 4.70 goals-against average. --Field Level Media

item.title: Steep bill for AI buildout punishes Meta, other tech favorites
item.description: The tab for the next round of the AI buildout came due on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Lewis Krauskopf, Sudeshna Ghoshal
item.content:encoded: The tab for the next round of the AI buildout came due on Thursday. Investors sold shares of Meta Platforms (META.O) and a wealth of companies central to the AI trade, a day after Meta -- one of the so-called hyperscalers spending billions to build data centers and other infrastructure supporting the AI boom -- said it would issue a new class of shares that will help it raise funds. Meta fell 8%, its largest drop since July. SpaceX (SPCX.O) declined 9% and semiconductor giant Nvidia (NVDA.O) -- a bellwether of the AI trade -- dropped 4%. The Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) was on track for its largest decline in four months. A 10% plunge in shares of semiconductor company Lam Research (LRCX.O) following its results also weighed on sentiment and sent the semiconductor index (.SOX) to its largest decline since July. The pullback is the latest test for the AI trade, focusing on the rising costs of a long-term project the payoffs from which remain uncertain and will likely be unevenly distributed. Tech firms have borrowed huge sums over the past year for AI spending, but Wall Street now expects that higher interest rates mean the likes of Meta will sell billions of dollars in stock to fund the next round of building – putting pressure on share prices by increasing the number of shares outstanding. It is an unwelcome development in a market where major US stock indexes remain near all-time highs despite a punishing month of volatile trading. Selling started with "the big question about the (return on investment) on all the spending," said Matthew Maley, chief market strategist at Miller Tabak. "It's just becoming more and more evident to people that it's going to take a lot longer." Thomas Hayes, chairman at Great Hill Capital LLC in New York, agreed that ROI concerns are central while also citing reported remarks by Nvidia (NVDA.O) CEO Jensen Huang about a financing bottleneck for smaller AI companies as contributing to the selling. Meta on Wednesday said it would use new Class C shares, which hold no voting power, to fund AI spending and other priorities . Meta also raised the low end of its annual spending forecast to $135 billion from $130 billion, with the high end unchanged at $145 billion. That level of spending will require lots of investor participation in coming stock sales. Meta reported negative free cash flow of $2.12 billion in the third quarter, compared with positive free cash flow of $10.63 billion a year earlier. It was the first cash burn at Meta in more than a decade. “More spending, negative free cash flow, not enough revenue being generated from the spend (is) concerning investors that this is just sort of a bit of a money pit,” said Robert Pavlik, senior portfolio manager at Dakota Wealth in Fairfield, Connecticut. The action highlights concern over how AI investment will be paid for. Credit default swaps tracking perceived default risk of many of the biggest AI players have risen over the past year, with Meta’s hitting a record on Thursday – reflecting uncertainty over who will benefit most from the sums being spent now. Fresh signs of market pressure to curb spending on AI quickly translated on Thursday into a broad market selloff reflecting expectations that any AI pullback would hit US growth, resulting in a sharp rally in Treasury prices . “The market seems to be real-time repricing the probabilities of a US ‘growth scare’ off the back of the AI reset,” Nomura Securities strategist Charlie McElligott wrote in a note to clients. Thursday’s selloff added to the pressure on the so-called neocloud companies at the heart of the AI buildout, with Nebius (NBIS.O) off 7% after announcing a new $3.5 billion credit line from Citigroup and CoreWeave (CRWV.O) , whose unsecured bond yields soared to 15% in last week’s AI selloff, down 9%. Bank of America analyst Tal Liani said in a report on Thursday he maintains a buy rating and a price target of $140 on CoreWeave stock heading into next month’s earnings report, though he said he believes the firm will need to raise $20 billion to fund commitments to customers -- the sort of prospect that is generating investor anxiety now across the technology industry. "Nobody is worried about Meta or Amazon or Google getting the financing they need," Maley said. "But if it gets prohibitive for smaller companies, then you don't have to have an implosion of things to make people nervous."

item.title: Merck/Moderna cancer vaccine cuts risk of melanoma death or recurrence by over 40%
item.description: Moderna and Merck said on Thursday that the mRNA cancer vaccine they developed combined with a widely used immunotherapy cut the risk of death or recurrence of melanoma by 42% and disease spread by 38% in a large trial.
item.dc:creator: Julie Steenhuysen, Michael Erman
item.content:encoded: Moderna (MRNA.O) and Merck (MRK.N) said on Thursday that the mRNA cancer vaccine they developed combined with a widely used immunotherapy cut the risk of death or recurrence of melanoma by 42% and disease spread by 38% in a large trial. The data from the Phase 3 trial of more than 1,100 patients potentially paves the way for a new era of personalized treatment. Moderna and Merck [USN:L1N44F0SC TEXT:"announced in August"] that the treatment had succeeded but did not provide details from the trial. It is the first to show that the combination of a vaccine based on mutations unique to each patient's tumor plus a drug that helps the immune system fight cancer can keep the disease at bay. The vaccine was tested along with Merck's blockbuster immunotherapy Keytruda, among the world's biggest-selling medicines. Moderna shares, which have rocketed since the August trial announcement, nearly quadrupling through Wednesday's close, fell over 20% after the results leaked on an oncology website earlier on Thursday. Merck shares were down about 0.7%. The results, based on patient data for the first two years after treatment, are scheduled to be presented on Saturday at the European Society for Medical Oncology meeting in Madrid. Several Wall Street analysts said before the meeting that investors were looking for the combination to cut the risk of recurrence by 40% or more. "This is highly statistically significant. It is not by chance," Dr. Hussein Tawbi, a melanoma expert and trial investigator at the University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center, said of the results. The trial tested nine doses of the vaccine, known as intismeran, along with Keytruda, beginning 13 weeks after surgery to remove melanoma lesions. Their response was compared with patients treated with just Keytruda, a standard therapy for melanoma. Among those who received the vaccine in addition to Keytruda, 82.2% were still cancer-free after two years, compared with 70% of patients who received Keytruda alone.

item.title: Police investigate burglary at Man United captain Fernandes' house, Athletic reports
item.description: Police are investigating a break-in at Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes' house in which intruders stole a number of items, according to a report by The Athletic.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Police are investigating a break-in at Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes' house in which intruders stole a number of items, according to a report by The Athletic. Cheshire Police launched an investigation after officers responded to reports of suspicious activity on Wednesday night at a residential address. "The caller reported three unknown men in the rear garden of a neighbouring property," Detective Inspector Dave Jarvis told The Athletic. "Officers attended the scene and on arrival there was no trace of the suspects. However, officers discovered that there had been a burglary at the address and a number of items had been stolen. "An investigation into the incident has been launched and enquiries are ongoing." The report said that police were alerted shortly after [USN:L6N46717X TEXT:"Manchester United's 4-1 Champions League defeat"] by Como in Italy. According to The Athletic, citing a club statement, no members of Fernandes' family were at the property during the break-in and the intruders spent less than five minutes inside before police arrived. Reuters has contacted Cheshire Police and Manchester United for comment. Fernandes has featured in every game for United this season and captained the side on Wednesday as they extended their winless run in all competitions to seven matches. Following the defeat, the 32-year-old called on his team to be [USN:L6N4671CM TEXT:""more brave""] after another disappointing result. United, who are 13th in the Premier League standings, host Bournemouth on Sunday.

item.title: Inundaciones provocadas por El Niño desplazan a miles en Paraguay mientras lluvias azotan Sudamérica
item.description: En el predio de la parroquia San Agustín, situada en uno de los barrios más afectados por las inundaciones causadas por el fenómeno climático El Niño en Paraguay, más de 30 familias se refugian de las lluvias y comparten alimentos donados mientras sus casas permanecen bajo agua.
item.dc:creator: Cesar Olmedo
item.content:encoded: En el predio de la parroquia San Agustín, situada en uno de los barrios más afectados por las inundaciones causadas por el fenómeno climático El Niño en Paraguay, más de 30 familias se refugian de las lluvias y comparten alimentos donados mientras sus casas permanecen bajo agua. Ubicados en Ciudad del Este, en la frontera con Brasil, San Agustín y San Rafael son dos de los barrios con mayor número de damnificados en el país por la crecida del caudaloso río Paraná y sus afluentes, en medio de las intensas precipitaciones atribuidas al evento meteorológico que han golpeado también a regiones de Chile, Argentina, Brasil y Perú. "Tuvimos que salir todos de nuestras casas porque (....) ya en varias oportunidades el agua ha tomado parte de nuestros hogares", dijo a Reuters Vicente Montiel, en el predio de la parroquia, donde varias familias se instalaron en carpas en una cancha de fútbol y organizan ollas comunes con la ayuda de la iglesia y empresas locales que proveen víveres. "No sabemos todavía si el agua va a retornar porque esta vez muchas familias quedaron con sus techos bajo agua y a pesar de que (el río) bajó, dicen que va a volver de nuevo. Vamos a estar acá hasta que se regularice el clima y el agua pare". La crecida del río Paraná ha dejado unas 4.200 familias damnificadas en Paraguay, en los departamentos del sureste del territorio que bordean el cauce, según la Secretaría de Emergencia Nacional (SEN). Una mujer de 58 años de Ciudad del Este murió la semana pasada tras el derrumbe de su vivienda debido a los fuertes raudales. MÁS LLUVIAS Ante el último pronóstico del miércoles de tormentas severas, las autoridades pidieron a los damnificados que no vuelvan a sus hogares y está trabajando para identificar más lugares donde construir viviendas temporales para albergues. La mayoría de las casas de los barrios San Rafael y San Agustín siguen bajo el agua y sus pobladores recorren las calles en pequeños botes para rescatar objetos que puedan salvarse o vigilar la zona. "Me sorprendió porque llegó muy rápido (el agua). Mi casa, mi cocina se cayó toda, se está derrumbando", dijo Antonina Sánchez, de 65 años, en San Rafael. "El barrio está todo tomado (...) muchas cosas perdimos y necesitamos mucho". El nivel del río en esa zona descendió levemente luego de alcanzar un máximo el 15 de octubre, pero las autoridades temen que vuelva a repuntar con las próximas lluvias previstas. El titular de la SEN, Arsenio Zárate, estimó que hasta 15.000 viviendas podrían sufrir las consecuencias de una nueva subida del río. "Estamos recabando los datos para ir reponiendo las mercaderías, ir completando lo que va faltando en cada toldo, en cada carpa", dijo a Reuters el director de Desarrollo Social de la alcaldía de Ciudad del Este, Julio Landaia. "Las ollas populares están continuamente siendo abastecidas". Funcionarios de la ONU advirtieron esta semana que el actual episodio de El Niño podría ser de una intensidad sin precedentes. Se espera que las temperaturas en el Pacífico central superen el promedio en unos 3,8 grados Celsius entre noviembre y enero, alcanzando su punto máximo alrededor de diciembre. El Niño se está haciendo sentir también en otras partes de América Latina. En Argentina, dos trabajadores rurales fallecieron mientras trasladaban ganado fuera de zonas inundadas próximas al río Paraná en la provincia de Corrientes, donde cientos de residentes han sido evacuados. En Perú, las autoridades anunciaron el jueves medidas de ayuda financiera y alivio fiscal para las empresas afectadas por fenómenos meteorológicos extremos frente a la costa del Pacífico. Parte de un complejo de condominios de lujo en la costa del Pacífico mexicano colapsó el miércoles, después de que el fuerte oleaje erosionara la arena bajo la edificación, dejando al descubierto sus cimientos y provocando que la estructura quedara peligrosamente inclinada hacia el mar.

item.title: Chiefs placing LT Josh Simmons (back) on injured reserve
item.description: Kansas City Chiefs left tackle Josh Simmons' rehab from a back injury has "plateaued" and he will be placed on injured reserve.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Kansas City Chiefs left tackle Josh Simmons' rehab from a back injury has "plateaued" and he will be placed on injured reserve. Head trainer Rick Burkholder provided an update Thursday on Simmons, who has been dealing with a bulging disc in his lower back since training camp. "Josh worked his tail off," Burkholder told reporters. "He worked diligently with my staff every day and has improved to the point where he returned to practice in a limited capacity last week. ... "However, we feel he's plateaued in the rehab process as he's trying to get to the final steps of recovery with a return to competition. And he's just not there yet." Simmons, 23, has missed the first five games for the Chiefs (5-0) and now will have to miss at least four more on IR. He will not be eligible to return until the Week 11 game against the Arizona Cardinals on Nov. 22. "He'll continue with the rehab process with the goal of returning to play at a high level that he achieved in the past," Burkholder said. "I just give (Simmons) a ton of credit for navigating through this injury to the point where surgery is not recommended and that he needs more time to return to full function." A 2025 first-round draft pick, Simmons made eight starts as a rookie last season. He missed four games in midseason for a personal matter and then missed the last five games after going on IR following a wrist injury. Undrafted rookie Kahlil Benson has started at left tackle in Simmons' absence. --Field Level Media

item.title: Lamar Jackson hits practice field, Ravens like chances of return
item.description: Lamar Jackson walked onto the practice field with teammates on Thursday with plans to participate as he works his way back from injuring his ankle on Oct. 4 against the Tennessee Titans.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Lamar Jackson walked onto the practice field with teammates on Thursday with plans to participate as he works his way back from injuring his ankle on Oct. 4 against the Tennessee Titans. The two-time MVP quarterback missed two games -- a Baltimore win at Atlanta and last week's loss in Cleveland -- recovering from the injury. He last played in the first half of the Ravens' Week 4 win over the Titans. "Any time he's out there, it kind of elevates the whole group. We're certainly excited about the direction that he's heading," Ravens offensive coordinator Declan Doyle said Thursday. "He's still got a lot of work to do in order to be able to play on Sunday, but he's really working at it behind the scenes. It's great having him in the meeting room. And it's another thing to be able to have him out there on the field with us and continuing to push and his teammates seeing him push and all that stuff." Jackson has six TD passes and one interception plus a rushing touchdown in 14 total quarters played in 2026. In his stead, Baltimore turned to Tyler Huntley at quarterback. Even with a much-improved defense, the Bengals -- Sunday's opponent -- are not a team likely to be thrilled to see Jackson on the field. He's 11-2 as a starter against Cincinnati with 3,699 total yards (2,868 passing) and 26 TDs (two rushing TDs). "Tyler's played a lot of games for them over the years, done a really good job," Bengals coach Zac Taylor said. "I don't think anybody replaces Lamar, just one for one. But Tyler does a great job where I don't feel like they have to change anything that they're really doing. He can still make plays with his feet, he's made a lot of plays with his arm. He's smart, he understands their system. I think he's played really well for them over the years." Both Baltimore quarterbacks planned to take reps with the first team on Thursday in preparation for Sunday's game. The Ravens are one of three 4-2 teams in the AFC North and lead the division in points (156) while ranking last in points allowed (132). Baltimore has 116 points and 14 touchdowns with Jackson at quarterback this season, compared to 40 points and four touchdowns without him. --Field Level Media

item.title: Ex-prosecutor’s killing puts Guatemala’s crime-politics nexus back in focus
item.description: Former Guatemalan anti-corruption prosecutor Juan Francisco Solorzano Foppa was one of the country's most high profile voices denouncing alleged links between politicians and business leaders and the country's increasingly powerful organized crime groups.
item.dc:creator: Sofia Menchu, Diego Oré
item.content:encoded: Former Guatemalan anti-corruption prosecutor Juan Francisco Solorzano Foppa was one of the country's most high profile voices denouncing alleged links between politicians and business leaders and the country's increasingly powerful organized crime groups. Over the weekend, [USN:L6N46307D TEXT:"he was shot dead"] on a soccer field, a killing that former officials and diplomats consulted by Reuters said has heightened concerns over organized crime's influence in the Central American nation. The killing of an outspoken former prosecutor who had publicly challenged powerful interests shocked the country and revived debate over criminal networks’ penetration of state institutions. "This is a threat against human rights defenders. This is a threat against activists for democracy," said Frank La Rue, a human rights advocate, who attended the wake for Solorzano Foppa on Monday, which featured portraits of the slain lawyer with his family. For many Guatemalans, it recalled the 1998 assassination of Bishop Juan Jose Gerardi, beaten to death two days after presenting a report documenting atrocities from the country’s civil war, and stirred fears that violence could again be used against prominent critics of powerful interests. Experts said criminal networks have strengthened their influence in recent years as anti-corruption efforts and institutions tasked with combating impunity have weakened, issues likely to loom over the June 2027 election as Guatemala chooses President Bernardo Arevalo’s successor. Authorities have not established a motive for Solorzano Foppa's killing. But officials and diplomats said the case has fueled concerns about criminal groups’ ability to intimidate or silence critical voices. More than 100 former prosecutors, judges, journalists and human rights defenders have left Guatemala in recent years, according to some international human rights organizations, after denouncing corruption or alleged links between state structures and criminal networks. This week, following Solorzano Foppa's killing, a high-profile lawyer who also railed against political corruption said he has received death threats. On Wednesday, Arevalo denounced the threats against the lawyer, Edgar Ortiz. "Guatemala cannot return to being a country where defending democracy can cost one peace, freedom, or their life," Arevalo wrote on social media. 'RED LINE CROSSED' Corruption has been a major institutional challenge in Guatemala for decades. From 2007 to 2019, the UN-backed International Commission against Impunity in Guatemala (CICIG) helped investigate corruption and organized crime networks within the state, including cases that led to the resignation and subsequent prosecution of then-President Otto Perez Molina and his former vice president, Roxana Baldetti. Since CICIG's departure in 2019, human rights groups, prosecutors and international observers have denounced setbacks in the fight against corruption. President Arevalo, who took office in 2024 promising to tackle the problem, has acknowledged difficulties advancing reforms and dismantling structures accused of corruption. In videos posted on Facebook, TikTok and Instagram, and seen by Reuters, Solorzano Foppa alleged links between Barrio 18 leader Aldo "El Lobo" Ochoa, who is serving combined prison sentences of more than 1,600 years, and people close to the leadership of the National Unity of Hope (UNE) party, headed by former first lady Sandra Torres. Reuters could not independently verify the allegations. UNE told Reuters in a statement that "those allegations were never proven and should not be presented as established facts." Solorzano Foppa, a former head of Guatemala's SAT tax administration agency, also alleged ties between criminal networks, political figures and sectors of the judicial system, though the accusations did not result in judicial proceedings. Officials have not identified who ordered the killing. The Organization of American States and the United Nations have called for a thorough investigation. The Public Prosecutor's Office did not immediately respond to a request for comment. On Sunday, following the murder, it said in a statement that "in order to guarantee due process, it will not disclose additional details about the evidence gathered or the specific lines of investigation." A former government official, who was not authorized to speak publicly, said insiders had turned to Solorzano Foppa with information they felt unable to expose themselves, making him an outlet for allegations from within the state. His killers "left no trace," the former official said, complicating the investigation. Guatemala's criminal networks range from gangs and drug traffickers to structures involving former officials and members of the security forces. Analysts say some have retained influence over state institutions, while armed groups like Barrio 18 and Mara Salvatrucha (MS-13) remain involved in extortion and territorial control. They include the so-called CIACS, or Illegal Clandestine Security Apparatuses, networks linked to former security structures that experts say retain political and economic influence. Guatemala is also a major drug-trafficking corridor to the United States, with groups associated with Mexico's Sinaloa Cartel and Jalisco New Generation Cartel operating through local criminal networks. "Many of us fear that a red line has been crossed," said Stephen McFarland, former US ambassador to Guatemala from 2008 to 2011. "A return to political assassination as a way of settling scores and protecting the ambitions and money of certain people."

item.title: Egypt calls for Yemen talks as parliament weighs military support to Saudi Arabia
item.description: Egypt advocates exploring "every opportunity" to resolve the Yemen conflict diplomatically, its foreign minister said, ahead of a parliamentary vote next week on authorising the armed forces to support Saudi Arabia against the Iran-aligned Houthis.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Egypt advocates exploring "every opportunity" to resolve the Yemen conflict diplomatically, its foreign minister said, ahead of a parliamentary vote next week on authorising the armed forces to support Saudi Arabia against the Iran-aligned Houthis. Any direct involvement of the Egyptian military, one of the region's largest, would raise the stakes in the conflict between the kingdom and the Houthis, an increasingly destabilising front in the spreading US-Israeli war on Iran . President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi called on Saturday for an urgent parliamentary session to authorise military involvement supporting the kingdom. After a closed session on Sunday, lawmakers [USN:S8N44Y029 TEXT:"postponed the vote until October 26"] to allow more deliberation. Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty and intelligence chief Hassan Rashad travelled to Riyadh on Wednesday to deliver a letter to Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman from Sisi, who said Egypt's support would be [USN:S8N45S05P TEXT:"limited to defending Saudi territory"] and borders rather than attacking Yemen. What kind of support Egypt will ultimately provide remains unclear. EGYPT HAS LIMITED ROLE IN SAUDI-LED YEMEN COALITION Abdelatty said on Thursday that Egypt underlined the need to "explore every opportunity for the possibility of reaching political solutions" ensuring a full Houthi withdrawal from territory seized during the group's advance in September near [USN:L8N4520BL TEXT:"the Bab el-Mandeb Strait"] — a critical chokepoint at the Red Sea's mouth and gateway to Egypt's Suez Canal. "So that we can move on the political path that we always emphasize, and also side by side in support of the defensive path for the kingdom," Abdelatty told a press conference. Clashes between the Houthis and the Saudi-led coalition backing Yemen's internationally recognized government have intensified since the group's push towards Bab el-Mandeb on the Red Sea further strained global oil supplies. The militia has since [USN:S8N44908G TEXT:"attacked Saudi airports and oil facilities"]. Saudi Arabia, the world's top oil exporter, is a vital strategic and economic partner for Egypt, providing billions in aid, central bank deposits and energy supplies under Sisi. The war in Yemen, which has caused a humanitarian crisis, started in 2014 when the Houthis drove the internationally recognised government out of the northern capital, drawing Saudi-led military intervention. Egypt joined the Saudi-led coalition in March 2015 mainly as a naval partner, sending warships to secure Red Sea shipping lanes while pledging air support. It also deployed around 800 ground troops but played only a limited combat role. A US-brokered truce in 2022 largely halted attacks. While Cairo has voiced support for Riyadh since the resumption of hostilities, it has avoided direct combat. It did not join the Mecca mutual defense pact linking Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Turkey, though it says membership remains under consideration. The Saudi crown prince [USN:P8N3ZN0LL TEXT:"sought military assistance from the United States"], but President Donald Trump did not agree to the US striking Houthis, three people familiar with the matter told Reuters in September. Washington told Riyadh that it would help with intelligence sharing and targeting, they added. Yahya Ali al-Rai, speaker of the Houthi-run House of Representatives, warned on Saturday against Egyptian involvement, urging parliament to reject the proposal. "Should Egypt slide down this path, it would pose a grave threat to its own national security and internal stability," he said.

item.title: Presidente da Romênia pede segurança a crianças após dois ataques violentos a escolas
item.description: O presidente romeno, Nicusor Dan, pediu ao governo nesta quinta-feira que garanta a segurança das crianças nas salas de aula e na internet, após dois ataques violentos em escolas em menos de uma semana.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente romeno, Nicusor Dan, pediu ao governo nesta quinta-feira que garanta a segurança das crianças nas salas de aula e na internet, após dois ataques violentos em escolas em menos de uma semana. A polícia informou que um adolescente de 15 anos atacou dois colegas de classe com um facão nesta quinta-feira em um banheiro de sua escola de ensino médio na cidade de Pitesti, na região central da Romênia. Na segunda-feira, um estudante de 13 anos esfaqueou e feriu um professor e outro aluno. A mídia local informou que ele havia feito publicações sobre seus planos nas redes sociais pouco antes do ataque. “Dois sinais que não podemos mais nos dar ao luxo de ignorar”, disse Dan em uma postagem no X. “Precisamos de escolas mais seguras, professores apoiados e preparados para intervir, acesso real a aconselhamento psicológico, mas também medidas para a proteção de menores no uso do espaço online”, acrescentou o presidente centrista. O governo recém-empossado da Romênia realizará uma reunião na sexta-feira para discutir medidas de segurança nas escolas. As escolas na Europa enfrentaram uma série de ataques neste ano em países como Polônia, França e Suécia, com as autoridades, em alguns casos, apontando o papel das redes sociais e das subculturas online que glorificam o assassinato como fator que fomenta a violência.

item.title: É falso que Flávio Bolsonaro tenha dito que férias de 30 dias são "exagero"
item.description: O candidato a presidente Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) não afirmou que férias de 30 dias são "um exagero", como dizem publicações nas redes sociais.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: O candidato a presidente Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) não afirmou que férias de 30 dias são "um exagero", como dizem publicações nas redes sociais. Estes são os principais detalhes: “Flávio: 'Trinta dias de férias é um exagero. Quinze dias é mais do que o suficiente'”, alegam os posts, que circulam no Facebook e no Instagram com uma foto do candidato. A imagem tem o logotipo da Jovem Pan News, mas não há registro da suposta notícia nos perfis da emissora no Instagram , no Facebook e no X . Além disso, a fonte usada nos posts é diferente da utilizada pela Jovem Pan News. O plano de governo de Flávio apresentado ao Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE) não menciona diminuir férias. “O custo de um trabalhador formal chega a cerca de duas vezes o salário que ele leva para casa... Vamos reduzir gradualmente o custo do trabalho, sem retirar direitos”, diz o documento. A Consolidação das Leis do Trabalho (CLT) assegura 30 dias de férias, sem prejuízo à remuneração, a cada ano de vigência do contrato de trabalho. A assessoria do candidato não havia respondido a um pedido de comentário até a publicação deste texto. Veredicto: Falso. Flávio Bolsonaro não disse que 30 dias de férias são um “exagero”, e a Jovem Pan News não publicou uma notícia com esta afirmação. Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. item.title: Macron endurece restrições a protestos na França e culpa extrema-esquerda pelos distúrbios
item.description: O presidente francês, Emmanuel Macron, afirmou nesta quinta-feira que protestos “ilegítimos” seriam proibidos nos próximos dias e atribuiu a culpa aos grupos de extrema-esquerda “sediciosos” e aos vândalos pelos distúrbios e saques ocorridos no último fim de semana.
item.dc:creator: Michel Rose
item.content:encoded: O presidente francês, Emmanuel Macron, afirmou nesta quinta-feira que protestos “ilegítimos” seriam proibidos nos próximos dias e atribuiu a culpa aos grupos de extrema-esquerda “sediciosos” e aos vândalos pelos distúrbios e saques ocorridos no último fim de semana. Após uma reunião com chefes de inteligência e ministros de alto escalão, Macron afirmou que manifestações organizadas por grupos como sindicatos teriam permissão para ocorrer, mas poderiam ser redirecionadas por percursos alternativos para proteger as lojas. “No último sábado, tivemos atos políticos e sediciosos por parte de grupos de extrema-esquerda cujo objetivo é derrubar a República”, disse ele. Seus comentários foram feitos enquanto as autoridades em toda a França se preparavam para novos protestos, após alguns dos piores distúrbios urbanos do país nos últimos anos. O ministro da Justiça, Gérald Darmanin, disse que deseja a suspensão do direito de voto para pessoas que desrespeitem as proibições de participação em manifestações, bem como restrições ao acesso às redes sociais para pessoas envolvidas em violência, saques ou ataques à polícia. Todos os protestos planejados para sábado em Marselha e Lyon, a segunda e a terceira maiores cidades da França, foram proibidos, informaram as autoridades locais. No entanto, novas manifestações já estão se organizando antes do que as autoridades temem que possa ser mais um fim de semana conturbado. A principal união estudantil da França, a Unef, convocou manifestações para sábado, enquanto o movimento dos Coletes Amarelos, força antissistema que surgiu em 2018, apresentou planos para uma marcha pelo centro de Paris. Comerciantes no centro de Paris começaram a proteger as vitrines de suas lojas com tábuas, em caso de violência. O grupo de artigos de luxo Hermès informou que reforçou as medidas de segurança em suas lojas na França. Os organizadores da feira internacional de colecionadores de arte Art Basel Paris, realizada em um centro de exposições no centro de Paris, informaram que o evento ficará fechado durante todo o fim de semana. Em outro local, as autoridades da cidade de Orléans, no norte do país, se preparavam para possíveis distúrbios, já que a extrema-direita, representada pelo Reunião Nacional, realizaria uma reunião anual, enquanto sindicatos e grupos de esquerda planejavam manifestações. Um protesto estudantil convocado para quinta-feira em Paris foi inicialmente proibido, mas acabou sendo autorizado a ocorrer; no entanto, as estações de metrô no centro de Paris foram fechadas pelas autoridades de transporte público em antecipação a aglomerações não autorizadas. INDIGNAÇÃO PÚBLICA A França foi abalada em 17 de outubro por atos de violência à margem dos protestos em todo o país, expondo a profundidade da indignação pública e levantando dúvidas sobre a capacidade dos serviços de segurança de manter a ordem. Duas pessoas foram presas por um incêndio criminoso na prefeitura de Limoges, segundo autoridades francesas e a mídia. A terceira noite consecutiva de toques de recolher locais transcorreu sem incidentes graves nas áreas afetadas pela violência, proporcionando ao governo um certo alívio antes do fim de semana. A agitação revelou um mal-estar mais profundo na França, onde os custos crescentes da energia, a pressão sobre o orçamento familiar e as preocupações com a deterioração dos serviços públicos têm alimentado uma frustração crescente entre os trabalhadores e os jovens. A classe política francesa também mergulhou em uma acirrada troca de acusações, com o governo acusando grupos políticos de extrema-esquerda de alimentar a agitação. Destacando o mal-estar dos investidores, o prêmio de risco da dívida pública francesa em relação aos títulos alemães, considerados refúgios seguros, ampliou-se nesta quinta-feira para o maior nível em 15 anos, enquanto o rendimento do título de referência francês de 10 anos atingiu 5,14%, seu nível mais alto desde julho de 2002.

item.title: Canadian dollar extends daily winning streak as interest rate spreads narrow
item.description: The Canadian dollar strengthened to a one-month high against its US counterpart on Thursday as oil prices rose and the gap narrowed between US and Canadian interest rates.
item.dc:creator: Fergal Smith
item.content:encoded: The Canadian dollar strengthened to a one-month high against its US counterpart on Thursday as oil prices rose and the gap narrowed between US and Canadian interest rates. The loonie was trading 0.3% higher at 1.4007 per US dollar, or 71.39 US cents, its strongest intraday level since September 21 and putting the currency on course for the sixth straight day of gains. The daily winning streak would be the longest since April. "Most importantly for the currency, the repricing of the Bank of Canada outlook has narrowed the two-year US-Canada yield spread," said Kevin Ford, an FX & macro strategist at Convera. "That has reduced the US dollar’s rate advantage at the same time that elevated oil prices have supported Canada’s terms of trade." The gap between Canada's 2-year yield and the equivalent US rate narrowed by 11 basis points to about 141 basis points in favor of the US note. Concerns about the sustainability of the AI outlook resurfaced, boosting the [USN:L6N468126 TEXT:"safe-haven appeal"] of US Treasuries. The price of [USN:L1N46801N TEXT:"oil"], one of Canada's major exports, rose after Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia stoked concerns of further disruption to energy supplies from the key exporting region. US crude oil futures were trading 2.2% higher at $99.26 a barrel. "The USD-CAD is looking to test the 1.40 level on the downside, but extending the move below that threshold will likely require further support from Canadian data and the Bank of Canada," Ford said. Investors see a roughly 75% chance the Bank of Canada will raise its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to 2.50% next Wednesday. Bets on a hike have increased in recent days after hawkish comments from BoC Governor Tiff Macklem and evidence of rising expectations for long-term inflation. Canadian retail sales data for August is due on Friday — analysts expect sales to rebound 1.3% after they declined 0.7% in July. Canadian government bonds tracked the moves in US Treasuries. The 10-year yield was down 7.8 basis points at 3.787%.

item.title: Estado de Rhode Island processa Meta por suposta tolerância a anúncios fraudulentos
item.description: O estado de Rhode Island, nos Estados Unidos, processou a Meta nesta quinta-feira em um tribunal estadual, devido à suposta tolerância da empresa à publicidade fraudulenta generalizada em suas plataformas Facebook, Instagram e WhatsApp.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O estado de Rhode Island, nos Estados Unidos, processou a Meta (META.O) nesta quinta-feira em um tribunal estadual, devido à suposta tolerância da empresa à publicidade fraudulenta generalizada em suas plataformas Facebook, Instagram e WhatsApp. O processo, movido pelo Procurador-Geral de Rhode Island, Peter Neronha, no Tribunal Superior de Providence, acusa a Meta de lucrar ilegalmente e participar da criação de bilhões de dólares em publicidade fraudulenta – mesmo enquanto assegurava a seus bilhões de usuários que estava trabalhando diligentemente para protegê-los. Este é o primeiro caso relacionado a golpes desse tipo movido contra a Meta por um estado dos EUA, após uma ação semelhante apresentada em maio pelo Condado de Santa Clara, na Califórnia. O processo busca indenizações civis monetárias por cada uma das supostas violações da lei estadual de Rhode Island cometidas pela Meta, restituição aos consumidores, devolução dos lucros ilícitos e uma ordem judicial que obrigue a empresa a lidar com os anúncios fraudulentos que desenvolve e veicula em suas plataformas, em vez de lucrar com eles. "Conforme alegado, Meta expôs conscientemente usuários vulneráveis a fraudes e golpes, obtendo lucros enormes com isso. Quando empresas, grandes ou pequenas, se aproveitam dos consumidores de Rhode Island, este escritório fará tudo ao seu alcance para responsabilizá-las", disse Neronha em um comunicado à imprensa. O processo cita reportagem da Reuters do ano passado sobre documentos internos da meta que detalham a vasta escala de publicidade fraudulenta nas plataformas da empresa – e os cálculos da Meta de que estava lucrando muito mais com anúncios fraudulentos de alto risco do que esperava pagar em multas por permiti-los. De acordo com esses documentos, a Meta exibe cerca de 15 bilhões de anúncios fraudulentos de "alto risco" para os usuários todos os dias e obteve aproximadamente 10% de sua receita de 2024 com comércio eletrônico fraudulento, produtos de saúde duvidosos e outros tipos de marketing proibidos. Em muitos casos, a ação judicial de Rhode Island alegou que as ferramentas de criação de anúncios com IA da Meta ajudaram ativamente os golpistas em suas práticas de marketing fraudulentas. Em vez de bloquear consistentemente os anunciantes que seus sistemas automatizados de detecção suspeitavam de fraude, Rhode Island alegou que a meta às vezes cobrava deles um valor extra como penalidade. "A Meta ajudou conscientemente a criar e otimizar esses anúncios para garantir que fossem o mais eficazes possível e, em seguida, mentiu sobre eles, deturpando para o público seu compromisso de prevenir fraudes em suas plataformas", afirmou o processo. A Meta não respondeu imediatamente a um pedido de comentário sobre o caso. A empresa contestou a reportagem da Reuters. "Combatemos agressivamente fraudes e golpes porque as pessoas em nossas plataformas não querem esse tipo de conteúdo, os anunciantes legítimos não o querem e nós também não", disse Andy Stone, porta-voz da Meta, em resposta à reportagem do ano passado, classificando-a como "uma visão seletiva que distorce a abordagem da Meta em relação a fraudes e golpes". Nos meses que se seguiram à publicação das reportagens da Reuters, a Meta alegou ter feito progressos em suas iniciativas de combate a golpes. No entanto, Rhode Island afirmou que os golpes continuam desenfreados e facilmente encontrados na biblioteca de anúncios da empresa, um banco de dados de anúncios veiculados nas plataformas da Meta. "O anúncio abaixo, por exemplo, prometia reverter Alzheimer em 45 dias", afirmou a denúncia de Rhode Island sobre um conjunto de anúncios fraudulentos. "Havia mais de 2.000 versões desse anúncio ativas na biblioteca de Meta Ads." COM FOCO NO PÚBLICO IDOSO Segundo apurou o estado de Rhode Island, os anúncios fraudulentos frequentemente tinham como alvo pessoas idosas, citando uma investigação do Centro para o Combate ao Ódio Digital (Center for Countering Digital Hate), uma organização sem fins lucrativos que identificou quase 94.000 anúncios fraudulentos nas plataformas da Meta. "Alguns desses anunciantes gastaram mais em anúncios da Meta ao longo de vários anos do que grandes marcas como Walmart ou Pfizer", afirmou o processo. Além dos golpes, o gabinete do procurador-geral de Rhode Island afirmou ter constatado que a Meta também estava falhando em fiscalizar outros tipos de anúncios ilícitos, como os de aplicativos de IA para pornografia deepfake. Em um exemplo fornecido pelo estado, um anúncio mostrava imagens lado a lado de uma mulher totalmente vestida em uma cafeteria, ao lado de uma imagem dela praticando um ato sexual. Rhode Island também citou exemplos de anúncios fraudulentos que se fazem passar por figuras públicas e instituições confiáveis, como bancos, para tirar proveito de sua credibilidade, incluindo um caso em que golpistas na China usaram o nome e a imagem de um alto executivo do Bank of America em anúncios no Facebook e Instagram que atraíam usuários para negociações fraudulentas de ações no WhatsApp. Dados de pesquisas públicas citados por Rhode Island – e avaliações internas da Meta obtidas pela Reuters – indicam que as plataformas da empresa são responsáveis por uma parcela desproporcional de golpes online e que as defesas da meta contra golpes eram mais fracas do que as de seus principais concorrentes em publicidade digital. "É mais fácil anunciar golpes em plataformas Meta do que no Google", concluiu uma análise interna da Meta em abril de 2025. Apesar disso, a Meta tentou frustrar os esforços regulatórios para exigir verificação, afirmou Rhode Island. O processo alegava que "um anunciante banido pode reaparecer no tempo necessário para fornecer um novo endereço de email ou número de telefone". (Por Jeff Horwitz e Katie Paul)

item.title: ECB's Santos Pereira pushes for deeper EU integration
item.description: ECB policymaker Alvaro Santos Pereira said on Thursday that Europe's difficult geopolitical environment and technological shortcomings show it is time to give fresh momentum to European integration by deepening the single market in services, transport and energy.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: ECB policymaker Alvaro Santos Pereira said on Thursday that Europe's difficult geopolitical environment and technological shortcomings show it is time to give fresh momentum to European integration by deepening the single market in services, transport and energy. The remarks by Portugal's central bank governor add to growing calls from European policymakers to deepen integration and remove barriers seen as weighing on the bloc's competitiveness and growth. The single market reduced many forms of fragmentation, he noted, but significant barriers persist. The remaining challenges are more complex because they are rooted in national institutions and regulations, he said at a conference. It was vital to complete integration in areas where it remains limited, including services, transport and energy, he added.

item.title: Paraguay's central bank under pressure over politically connected lender
item.description: Paraguay's central bank and its president face mounting calls to resign as scrutiny intensifies over how they supervised a fast-growing digital bank with political ties.
item.dc:creator: Daniela Desantis
item.content:encoded: Paraguay's central bank and its president face mounting calls to resign as scrutiny intensifies over how they supervised a fast-growing digital bank with political ties. Senators from the ruling party and the opposition have urged President Santiago Peña to remove the central bank's top leadership, despite it being credited with helping [USN:S0N3ZU04S TEXT:"Paraguay"] secure investment-grade status. The case is testing the reputation that has helped Paraguay become one of South America's emerging destinations for foreign capital, much of it from neighboring Brazil. In recent weeks, authorities have repeatedly tried to calm financial markets after it emerged that ueno bank faced regulatory scrutiny of its business and an administrative investigation. The bank uses lower case in company statements. In written statements to Reuters, Paraguay's central bank defended its governance structure, saying regulatory and supervisory processes operate independently and in accordance with established legal procedures. Ueno said it would continue to "fully cooperate" with the central bank and maintained that the preliminary administrative proceeding did not constitute a finding of wrongdoing. Ueno has scaled rapidly from a niche local fintech player to a mid-tier bank, in line with digital platforms like [USN:L6N45I01U TEXT:"Monzo"] and [USN:S0N44O08P TEXT:"Nubank"]. It says it has 3 million customers and manages roughly $800 million to $850 million in public funds. Details of the preliminary probe appeared in a central bank report sent to the Senate this month. The report aimed to dispel doubts about loans issued by ueno to related companies, but it ended up fueling more questions from lawmakers, the banking association and other business groups. "The replacement of the Central Bank authorities must take place," ruling-party Senator Gustavo Leite said in an interview with Reuters. "The people at the Central Bank have lost credibility." Opposition Senator Rafael Filizzola said the financial system was "suffering" and filed another request for information on ueno, which experienced a major selloff of its global bonds. Fitch Ratings changed the outlook on the company's securities from stable to negative last week. Paraguay's Banking Association, which represents 14 private lenders including Brazil's Itau [RIC:RIC:ITUPU.UL], published a statement on October 18 reiterating that the central bank's response to the senate was "incomplete." POLITICAL TIES The case is politically sensitive. Paraguay's central bank president, Carlos Carvallo, previously worked at ueno and served as its president until August 2023, the company confirmed in a statement to Reuters. Peña, a former [USN:L4N3K813R TEXT:"economist"], was a business partner of the group that owned the bank until March 2025. Ueno said Peña never had a relationship with the bank itself as a shareholder or investor. Much of the pressure for answers has come from lawmakers of the ruling Colorado Party, amid an internal dispute over the party's presidential nomination for the 2028 general elections. In a written response to Reuters, the central bank said there was no conflict of interest, saying Carvallo had "recused himself" from all decisions related to ueno bank. Paraguay’s presidency did not respond to a request for comment. In remarks to local media in early October, Peña described the situation as an "overflow" of a technical matter that was taken into the political arena and had done "tremendous damage to the image of the entire country." The ueno case has put a spotlight on stability in Paraguay's grain-exporting economy that won investment-grade credit ratings from Moody's in 2024 and S&P Global last year. The IMF expects growth of 4.5% this year, almost double the [USN:L6N46117N TEXT:"regional average"].
